status.description: answered commits to one numeric result; abstained makes no single numeric commitment.

answer.description: For answered, an unsigned absolute decimal magnitude STRING at answer_format.decimal_places, in the scale requested by Q or established by C. Digits and a decimal point only. No currency, sign, comma, percentage symbol, unit, or scale word. For abstained, null.

negative.description: For answered, true iff the final rounded result is negative; false for zero. For abstained, null. The only field carrying the sign.

scale.description: Reporting scale of the numeric answer from Q/C. Null if unknown. A record of the requested representation, not a currency name and not an instruction to multiply the reported coefficient again.

answer_meta.description: Metadata for this computed answer. Keep the sign and reporting scale here; do not place them at the top level.

explanation.description: A brief English justification with the key calculation or reason for abstaining. No detailed internal reasoning trace.

evidence.description: Exact excerpts from the question or context. Empty array if there is no relevant excerpt.
